messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — need to change who is primary on my kid's insurance. Ex-partner just lost employer coverage. Is that a QLE and what docs do you need?

Jordan (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, Alex. Yes, loss of other coverage is typically a qualifying life event. Well need proof that the other plan ended and the date of termination.

Alex Chen: Cool. What counts as proof? They said theyre on COBRA now but haven't enrolled.

Maya (Benefits): @Alex Proof options: 1) Carrier termination letter or notification, 2) COBRA notice showing loss of active coverage, or 3) employer HR confirmation email stating coverage end date. Screenshots ok if they have official headers and dates.

Alex Chen: Got it. Do I have to provide custody paperwork to enroll the child? We share custody equally.

Jordan (People Ops): If the child is already an eligible dependent on your plan (e.g., previously enrolled), we don't need custody docs just for switching primary responsibility due to loss of other coverage. If the child isn't yet on your plan, then yes we might ask for proof of relationship (birth certificate) and sometimes custody if the carrier requests it.

Maya (Benefits): Also note: carriers sometimes enforce coordination of benefits rules. Well submit the QLE to the insurer and they may ask additional docs. We recommend you forward the termination/COBRA notice to benefits@redwood.com ASAP.

Alex Chen: Timeline? If I submit today, when would coverage start?

Maya (Benefits): Typically coverage effective date is the date the other coverage ended or the date you request (carrier-dependent). Most carriers allow backdating to the date of loss up to 30 days if we submit within the allowed window (usually 30-60 days). Some require mid-month effective dates. We'll confirm with the insurer when we open the case.

Alex Chen: Will payroll deductions be prorated? I just got paycheck with full premium taken.

Jordan (People Ops): Payroll handles proration once benefits updates are processed. If the effective date is mid-pay period, you could see either a retro credit or prorated deductions in the next pay cycle. If retro credit needed beyond payroll calendar, we can request an adjustment.

Alex Chen: Is there a specific subject line for the email to benefits?

Maya (Benefits): Use subject: "QLE - Loss of other coverage - add dependent" and attach the termination/COBRA doc + dependent info (name, DOB, SSN last 4). Well reply with the carrier case number and next steps.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Also, do I need to pick a PCP or is that optional during midyear add?

Maya (Benefits): For HMO plans, carriers often require a PCP selection at enrollment. For PPO/HDHP, it's optional. If you dont pick one, the carrier may auto-assign. We'll include PCP selection in the enrollment form we send back.

Alex Chen: One more: if the other parents COBRA gets reinstated later, do we need to switch back?

Jordan (People Ops): You can switch during another QLE (gain of other coverage) if that happens. Keep copies of all notices. Open enrollment also gives an annual window to change.

benefits-bot: Reminder: Submit QLE docs within 60 days of coverage loss to be considered for prospective/backdated enrollment.

Alex Chen: Sending docs now. Appreciate the quick help.
